title: Spurious Correlation-Aware Embedding Regularization for Worst-Group Robustness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset, where gender acts as a spurious attribute for predicting hair color (blond vs. not blond).
Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments dataset, where mentions of various demographic groups act as spurious attributes for toxic language classification.
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the Waterbirds and MetaShift datasets, where image backgrounds (e.g., water/land or indoor/outdoor) spuriously correlate with the target objects.
Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the MultiNLI dataset, where the presence of negation words serves as a confounding spurious feature strongly correlated with contradiction labels.
Measuring worst-group accuracy under varying levels of injected spurious correlations on the synthetic ColorMNIST dataset, where digit color is disproportionately associated with specific classes.
